name: candor-ui
description: Build agent product UIs with Candor UI, a shadcn/ui registry of React components for agents that do real work. Installs the candor-ui skill (which component fits which job, the adapters, the honesty rules) and the candor MCP server, which serves Candor's docs and component suggestions only: read-only, no key, never paid source.

interface.shortDescription: Components for agent UIs, with a docs MCP server that is read-only and keyless.
interface.longDescription: Candor UI is a shadcn/ui registry of React components for agents that do real work: chat, tool calls, plans, approvals, diffs, run logs, traces, evals, admin and the app shell around them. This plugin installs the candor-ui skill, which says which component fits which job, how the Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK and AG-UI adapters are wired, and the honesty rules every Candor screen keeps. It also connects the candor MCP server, which serves Candor's docs and component suggestions only: read-only, no key or sign-in, and never paid source.
